extraction.Name: Rosa DuBray (Iron Shell)
extraction.NOTES: Document is a cover letter from Superintendent E. E. McKean to the Commissioner of Indian Affairs, dated July 6, 1929, Rosebud, South Dakota, enclosing an affidavit of Rosa DuBray (Iron Shell) in connection with a fee patent issued under the 'Declaration of Policy.' A report on similar cases was forwarded June 22nd and it is requested this affidavit be added to that report. E. R. Rusho, mentioned in her affidavit, is reported to be unreliable and connected with a number of other patent cases, but a judgment against him would be of little value.
